theme.title: NBA Mix 47
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: How many points did David Robinson score against the Clippers on April 24, 1994?
questions.note: 71, breaking George Gervin's Spurs record of 63.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scoring 71 points (breaking George Gervin's single-game franchise record of 63) against the Los Angeles Clippers

funFacts.text: Robinson's scoring-title chase came down to a direct duel with Shaquille O'Neal.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he became locked in a duel for the NBA scoring title with Shaquille O'Neal

funFacts.text: His outburst surpassed George Gervin's longstanding Spurs single-game points record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: breaking George Gervin's single-game franchise record of 63

funFacts.text: That season, Robinson also averaged double-digit rebounds and more than three blocks per game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 10.7 rebounds per game, career-high 4.8 assists per game and 3.3 blocks per game

questions.prompt: Against the Knicks in 1995, Reggie Miller scored how many points in 8.9 seconds?
questions.context: 1995 East semifinals · Game 1 · at New York

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored eight unanswered points in 8.9 seconds in Game 1

funFacts.text: The comeback featured a stolen inbounds pass from Anthony Mason between Miller's dramatic jumpers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: stole the inbound pass from Anthony Mason

funFacts.text: John Starks missed both free throws on New York's next possession, leaving the door open for Indiana.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Starks missed both free throws

funFacts.text: Patrick Ewing grabbed the offensive rebound but his putback bounced off the back rim.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: his shot was just a bit long and hit the back rim

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Jamal Murray average in the 2023 NBA Finals?
questions.note: 10.0 assists a night, complementing Jokić's scoring and passing.

funFacts.text: Murray had torn his ACL before the 2021 playoffs and missed the entire following season while recovering.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jamal Murray, who was crucial to the Nuggets' playoff runs in 2019 and 2020, tore his ACL a month before the start of the 2021 playoffs

funFacts.text: In Game 4 of the Finals, Murray recorded 12 assists without committing a single turnover.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Murray, who committed seven turnovers in game 3, finished the game with 12 assists and zero turnovers

funFacts.text: In Game 1, Murray and Jokić became the first Finals teammates since Magic Johnson and James Worthy to each have 25-plus points and 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jokić and Murray also became the second pair of teammates to each put up at least 25 points and 10 assists

questions.prompt: How many home games did the 2010–11 Bulls win at the United Center?
questions.note: 36 wins at home against only five defeats.

funFacts.text: Chicago finished its regular season with only five home defeats.
The Bulls ended the season by winning every game they played during April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: April: 8–0 (home: 4–0; road: 4–0)

funFacts.text: The team set a franchise mark for converted three-pointers in a March game against Utah.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On March 12 the Bulls set a franchise record 18 converted 3-point shots

questions.prompt: In 1999 the Spurs set a record for consecutive playoff wins. How many did they win before the streak ended in the Finals?
questions.note: 12 straight, the longest in NBA history at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was the end of the Spurs' 12-game playoff winning streak, the longest in NBA history at the time.

funFacts.text: That championship came after a lockout shortened the regular season to 50 games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: was shortened from the usual 82-game schedule to 50 games per team

funFacts.text: The Knicks became the first eighth-seeded team to advance all the way to the NBA Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first team in North American sports history to reach a championship series as an eighth seed

funFacts.text: San Antonio swept both the Lakers and Trail Blazers en route to its first Finals trip.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: recorded back-to-back sweeps in the second round and the conference finals
